description: Get the full directory entry for one API by its exact APIs.guru name/key (e.g. "stripe.com" or "googleapis.com:calendar"). Returns every version of that API with its info (title, description, provider, categories), last-updated date, docs link, and OpenAPI/Swagger spec URLs (swaggerUrl JSON + swaggerYamlUrl YAML), plus which version is preferred. Use this once you know the exact name (from search_apis) to fetch the spec URLs for an API.

name.description: Exact APIs.guru directory key, e.g. "stripe.com" or "googleapis.com:calendar".
